newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - March 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - March 6.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Commerce minister holds talks with German minister of state on ways of expanding trade between the two countries.
- Compaq plans to sell more computers in Saudi Arabia, opens office in the kingdom to tap growing market.
- The United States wants to cut Gulf trade barriers.
- Crown Prince Abdullah opens Saudi national heritage and culture festival, Janadriya.
- An Australian trade and industrial team to visit Saudi this month for talks to boost cooperation.
- Saudi Arabia to build a new $2.5 billion petrochemical plant.
- Saudi Arabia to reduce charges of local telephone calls from Friday.
